section_summary.extract_value: This section details further analyses conducted on a single study, focusing on the 'General Body Appreciation factor' after excluding the 'Body Image Investment factor' due to low internal consistency. It reports ANOVA results showing no significant main effect of ethnicity (Javanese, Sundanese, Chinese) or ethnicity by gender interaction on General Body Appreciation. However, a significant main effect of gender was found, with women having lower General Body Appreciation than men. Finally, General Body Appreciation was significantly correlated with BMI for both women (r = -.30) and men (r = -.22).
